_comment: Machine-readable role/permission template, mirroring the role-default + per-user-exception model in blueprint/05-roles-permissions-security.md. Role KEYS below are Sanad's originals for reference; rename per COMPANY-ONBOARDING-TEMPLATE.md answers. The permission catalogue keys (group.action shape) are the reusable mechanism (tag A) — keep this shape even when relabeling roles.

super_tier._comment: Not a role — a boolean flag on the top administrative role, with no permission ceiling and a protected last-one-standing guarantee. Keep this mechanism (tag A/H) regardless of role renaming.

admin.notes: The top operational role below Super Admin.

supervisor.default_permissions: Broad operational access; NOT users.manage, NOT settings.manage, NOT erase

lawyer.default_permissions: Own-file access only (no requests.view_all by default)
lawyer.notes: Front-line service-delivery role — rename to match the company's actual staff title (e.g. 'accountant_staff', 'consultant').

enforcement_notes._comment: Copy these mechanisms verbatim into any rebuild — they are Core Platform DNA (tag A/H), not brand or company choices.
